blurb:
Experience the best of Victoria with our unique combo city tour and Butchart Gardens adventure! We offer a hotel pickup service, so you can relax and enjoy the journey right from your front door. 

Our tour is not just about transportation; it's about creating memorable experiences and capturing stunning Instagram-worthy pictures along the way. During the one-hour city tour, we'll take you to key picturesque spots in Victoria, showcasing the city's beauty and charm. 

But the highlight of the tour is our visit to the iconic Butchart Gardens. With your entry ticket included, you'll have the freedom to explore this world-renowned garden at your own pace. (2.25 hours) 

Book your spot now and get ready for an unforgettable experience!

We keep each tour departing with 12 or less people.
Tour ~ 5 hours (Includes transportation time)

1pm option- Gardens first followed with City Tour
